subject.title: fix(skills): forward owner handle to bulk security-verdict fetch for ambiguous slugs

question: Should OpenClaw wait for an owner-aware ClawHub bulk-verdict contract, or should it implement a bounded owner-qualified single-verify fallback when bulk lookup returns `skill_not_found`?
rationale: The existing issue evidence says the exact request shape introduced here already fails at the external service, while choosing a client fallback changes the intended cross-service failure behavior.

options.title: Verify and land the direct contract
options.body: Land a pass-through-only fix only after a real ClawHub bulk request with `ownerHandle` returns the expected clean verdict.

options.title: Add a bounded fallback
options.body: On a known owner-qualified linked skill, fall back to owner-qualified single-skill verify after the specific bulk lookup failure and cover both paths.

options.title: Pause for ClawHub API work
options.body: Keep this PR unmerged until ClawHub provides an owner-aware bulk endpoint and its contract is documented or otherwise proven.

recommendation.title: Add a bounded fallback
recommendation.body: On a known owner-qualified linked skill, fall back to owner-qualified single-skill verify after the specific bulk lookup failure and cover both paths.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main ownership history could not be inspected; the decision should route to the person responsible for the skills-security and ClawHub API boundary.
